overall_goal: Pour and spread dosa batter on a hot pan, and coat it with oil and ghee.

goals.description: Wash and dry a cup for the ghee
goals.rationale: The person retrieves, washes, and dries a cup to prepare it for holding the ghee.

goals.description: Transfer ghee into the cup and set it to melt
goals.rationale: The person weighs and squeezes ghee into the cup, then places it on the hob to melt.

goals.description: Unpack a new ladle for spreading the batter
goals.rationale: The person uses scissors to remove the cardboard packaging from a brand new ladle.

goals.description: Pour and spread dosa batter on the pan
goals.rationale: The person scoops dosa batter from the bowl and spreads it evenly in a circular motion on the hot pan.

goals.description: Coat the first dosa with olive oil
goals.rationale: The person uses a spoon to sprinkle olive oil around the edges of the cooking dosa.

goals.description: Coat the first dosa with ghee
goals.rationale: The person drizzles melted ghee over the dosa to help it cook well.

goals.description: Pour and spread batter for a second dosa
goals.rationale: The person scoops more batter and spreads it on the pan to make another dosa.

goals.description: Coat the second dosa with olive oil
goals.rationale: The person drizzles olive oil onto the second dosa as it cooks.

goals.description: Coat the second dosa with ghee
goals.rationale: The person drizzles ghee over the second dosa to finish coating it.
